fact: The National Treasury's addendum of 13 April 2026 says the Konza National Data Centre, through the Konza Cloud Platform, hosts 145 of 451 government institutions and is intended to host national government systems as SaaS.
title: Updated Addendum III, Transaction Advisory Services for the Konza Cloud Expansion and Smart City Facilities (RFP No. PPPD/0&S/RFP/05/2025-2026)
publisher: The National Treasury, State Department for Public Investments and Assets Management
